title: vitex agnus-castus var. ovata
intro: Vitex agnus-castus var. ovata, commonly known as Chaste Tree, is a deciduous shrub native to the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used to support female reproductive health, with reported health benefits including relief from menstrual cramps, premenstrual syndrome (PMS), and menopausal symptoms. The therapeutic actions of Vitex agnus-castus var. ovata are attributed to its ability to regulate hormonal balance, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, including aucubin, rosmarinic acid, and agnuside.
